doc:
Toggle "quake-style" apps: summon, place, and auto-hide by action.

Configurable properties (with default values):
    apps = {},
    defaultHeight = 0.45,
    defaultWidth = 1.0,

Example:
```
spoon.QuakeApps.apps = {
  terminal = {
    bundleID = "net.kovidgoyal.kitty",
    placement = "topHalf",
    hotkey = { { "cmd" }, "`" },
  },
  browser = {
    app = "Google Chrome",
    placement = "middle",
    width = 0.7,
    hotkey = { { "cmd", "alt" }, "b" },
  },
}
```
